caption: The drawing depicts a tall, ornate clock with a circular face at the top. The clock face is white with black Roman numerals marking the hours and two black clock hands, and bears the inscription “Willard, Boston.” The upper portion of the clock is flanked by two small decorative orbs and is topped with a finial. The central body of the clock features two vertical, slightly curved panels with a gold background, decorated with red, blue, and green floral motifs within raised, gold-trimmed borders. The clock stands on a rectangular base, which is bordered in gold and decorated with a painted scene showing a person driving a chariot pulled by two horses, set against a yellow-orange sky; this scene is framed by a colorful, ornamented border with red, green, and blue elements. The drawing appears on a plain, off-white background, and the artist’s name “ULRICH FISCHER” is written in gray in the lower left corner.
title: Banjo Clock
